title: pyrrosia mollis
intro: Pyrrosia mollis, commonly known as Soft Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrosia mollis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds and flavonoids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Pyrrosia mollis for medicinal purposes.
